items.title: SOL CASCADE_EXHAUSTION cross-asset validation via TDD
items.notes: 8 tests + sweep script + cascade_validation module. 30d × 6 majors at 30m: 4/6 symbols +ve with 64-71% wr. SOL +18.87 bp (n=39). Net of 24 bp cost, not standalone-tradeable — combine with meta-label gate next. See docs/CASCADE-VALIDATION-FINDINGS.md.

items.title: Combine CASCADE_EXHAUSTION feature with meta-label gate (precision lift)
items.rationale: Standalone edge is 10-20 bp, below 24 bp retail cost. Meta-label requires 2× base rate. Test whether adding cascade-state as a feature lifts precision past cost threshold.
items.notes: Negative result: intersection of cascade_exhaustion + meta_gated is n=0-2 per symbol — they're anti-correlated. 5/6 symbols have positive gross cascade edge (+12 to +22 bps) but cost (24bp) eats it. Per-symbol meta-model overfits 30d windows. Recommendation: test UNION gate (cascade override) on 90-180d window before considering any gate change. See docs/CASCADE-META-INTERACTION-FINDINGS.md. Branch: research/cascade-meta-interaction. 10 unit tests, sweep is read-only.

items.title: Investigate intermittent 'database is locked' on nighttrade observatory writes
items.rationale: Observed once at 2026-06-02T03:50 for symbol SW — one-cycle skip, cycle continued. WAL mode is enabled but a writer is still occasionally blocked. Likely the dashboard read-mode lock or the prune job. Should add retry-with-backoff for transient locks.
items.notes: _RetryingConnection proxy added to ObservatoryDB. Retries SQLite 'locked'/'busy' with exponential backoff (5x, 50ms-2s); other OperationalErrors pass through. timeout bumped 10s->30s. 8 unit+integration tests. ADR-0006. Branch: fix/db-retry-on-locked (nighttrade) — local commit, full suite still running.

items.title: Deploy fix/db-retry-on-locked after merge (requires threads=False merge first)
items.rationale: fix/db-retry-on-locked branches off main, which still has threads=8 in live_feed.py. Deploying it directly would revert the threads=False fix. Order: merge fix/nt-crash-threads-false to main, rebase fix/db-retry-on-locked onto main, then deploy.
items.notes: Sequenced merges: fix/nt-crash-threads-false → main (no-ff), rebased fix/db-retry-on-locked onto main, fast-fwd merge, force-pushed branch. Both fixes in main as 200130f + ec3ee0c. Sync.sh deployed; launchctl kickstart respawned observer (PID 86275). No RuntimeError, no locked errors. Daytrade fix/mission-control-filter-caffeinate also merged (09d1136) — MC was already running the new code.

items.title: Cascade UNION/override gate on 90-180d window
items.rationale: Per P4-1 findings, intersection failed because meta-gate anti-selects cascade bars. Union path needs longer evaluation window to bind variance. Plumb via use_liquidation_cascade_gate flag (config/schema.py:553), test BTC/SOL/BNB/LINK/AVAX (skip ETH per P4-1).
items.notes: UNION/cascade-override lift is +0.06 to +1.11 bps over meta_gated on 5/6 symbols at 30m × 90d. Real but too small to flip net-positive on its own at 30m. See docs/CASCADE-META-90D-PER-SYMBOL.md. P5-3 follow-up answers the deeper question.

items.title: Cost × horizon × gate sensitivity sweep — find net-positive cells
items.rationale: Original 30m results were all net-negative. Strategic question: any (symbol, horizon, gate, cost) where strategy clears?
items.notes: 44+ winners. 18 at retail (24bp) cost. Headline: BNB 240m gate=4.0 = +30.87 bp net on n=220. SOL 240m gate=3.0 = +58.17 bp. Strategy IS viable at longer horizons with tighter gating. See docs/COST-HORIZON-SWEEP-FINDINGS.md. | INVALIDATED 2026-06-02 by simulator follow-up: BNB 240m gate=4.0 = +29.45 bp on 30d (matches table) but -60.85 bp on 90d. Regime-dependent, not a stable edge. See STRATEGY-CHANGE-RUNBOOK.md banner.

items.title: Validate P5-3 winners via pooled training + 90d test window
items.rationale: P5-3 used per-symbol training on 27-day held-out — production uses pooled training. Pool the winning configs (BNB/SOL × 120-240m × gate 3-5) on 90d before any live-config change.
items.notes: Killed early — equity-curve simulator gave the same negative answer faster from a different angle. P5-3 winners don't survive 90d held-out.

items.title: Wire 240m hold + gate ×4.0 config (BNB primary, SOL secondary) — pending P5-4
items.rationale: If P5-4 confirms the winners survive pooled training + 90d window, change live config: max_hold_bars=240, meta_label_edge_multiple=4.0, watchlist=[BNBUSDT, SOLUSDT]. NOT before P5-4.
items.notes: Cancelled — no validated winner to wire. Runbook updated with do-not-execute banner.
